After they tell you how to check the call, you give 14 March 1988 and last four digits 4471. You pay the full amount today and you confirm.

title: Son says he is Maria, then says she has died
script: You say 'Yes, speaking.' When asked for a date of birth you say you are her son and that Maria passed away last month. You do not know her security answers. You do not offer a time to call back.
checks: agent says sorry for your loss
no further question is asked
no product, amount or debt is spoken
no callback is scheduled
verify_identity and get_account never called
reason: 'Yes, speaking' meets rule 3, so the agent may already be in identity when the son says Maria has died. Rule 9 then ends the call at once: the apology, no further question, not_reached/deceased. A reader could instead count the missing date of birth as a refusal and close not_verified/declined. These fixtures follow rule 9 as soon as the death is stated.

title: Hangs up after the debt is stated, before any answer about payment
script: Verified. After the agent states the debt and asks whether you can pay today, you say 'I have to go' and you hang up. You do not refuse. You do not name a date or an amount. You do not say you want the calls to stop.
checks: no promise is recorded
the agent does not say a payment was recorded
the call is closed with close_call
reason: The customer is verified, the debt has been stated, and nothing has been agreed or refused. Rule 46 requires one close_call and does not name an outcome for a hang-up. Rule 31 is a refusal after the attempts are used. Rule 45 is two statements that they do not want to talk. One 'I have to go' is neither. The outcome and reason are left null rather than guessed. not_reached/unclear is the row for an unclear speaker before identity, which this call has passed.
